info.text:
Interest on America's debt: about $115 billion in one month.
The Treasury's October report (Nov 12, 2026) showed a record October deficit of $404.1 billion, up 42% from $284.3 billion a year earlier.
The government took in $368.9 billion and spent $773 billion. Adjusted for payments shifted from November, the gap was $285 billion, still up 49%.
Gross interest on the debt: $115 billion, up about 11%. Separately, the 10-year Treasury yield ended Friday above 5%.
Sources: US Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement; Reuters; 24/7 Wall St.
News and education, not financial advice.
